directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a letter to a foreign friend who wants to learn Chinese. Please recommend a place to him. You should write at least 120 words but no more than] 80 words
sample_essay:
Dear friend,

I'm thrilled to hear about your interest in learning Chinese. I'd like to recommend Beijing as an ideal place for you to study this language.

To begin with, Beijing is home to numerous top-notch language institutions. For example, Peking University offers high-quality Chinese courses taught by experienced professors, which can provide you with a solid foundation in Chinese. In addition, the city is rich in cultural resources. You can visit the Forbidden City, the Great Wall and other historical sites, where you can not only experience traditional Chinese culture but also practice your Chinese with local guides. Furthermore, Beijing has a large international community. You can easily find language exchange partners, which will greatly improve your speaking skills.

In conclusion, Beijing is a great place for learning Chinese. I believe you'll have a wonderful time here.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
